fact: The Government of Cabo Verde states that the Cadastro Social Único is the base of the country's social support system, and that a registered eligible household can access targeted support including cash transfers, food security support and resilience programmes.

The ministry's page says the CSU, created by Decreto Regulamentar 7/2018, is the prior condition for access to public safety-net benefits such as social water and energy tariffs, school transport and kits, higher-education fee support and health user-fee exemption, and will be the reference database for municipalities, utilities, the health, education, housing and family ministries and the Centro Nacional de Pensões Sociais.
The Cabo Verde minister says about 16 social programmes draw beneficiaries from the single social registry (CSU).
